score_scale: V DN; 255*linear sRGB Y; 255*OKLab L; VS=(maxRGB+minRGB)/2=V(1-S/2)
srgb_assumption: Treat decoded JPEG RGB samples as sRGB, matching prior analysis; no scene-linear exposure or recovered illumination claim
averaging: Transform each native pixel FIRST, then arithmetic mean; do not transform mean RGB
climbing: R268 deterministic strict 8-neighbor ascent; no equal steps; converted running raw-score 12-DN-equivalent guard
thresholds: For score m: floor_m(ref,d)=g_m(max(0,g_m_inverse(ref)-d)); g_m is response to neutral sRGB gray. Raw budgets12/24, mean budgets2/6. Neutral equivalence does not prove equal colored-image barriers.
color: Identical original HSV hue/saturation and background rules; HSV V in reliability tests is fixed color evidence, not the optimized brightness score
common_guard_control: Original V climb anchor and original V running-peak raw24 floor, converted mean2 floor; all radii. Separates score ranking from changed anchors/raw guards.
max_source: All regional plateau pixels intersecting each original crop, with 192-pixel context; independent raw and mean maxima for every score; no prominence gate
baseline: V legacy starts must exactly reproduce R268 guarded/unguarded paths and all R269 broad endpoints
